quests.title: The Chef's Tale

dialogue.t: Hey, newbie. You can't be making food like that.
We're making rations for the Ratniki on the island, so we've gotta cook it to their tastes.
These dishes won't do at all. First, your heat control's terrible, and second, this stuff doesn't suit our diet. That's gotta change.
You've still got a lot to learn — I suggest starting from our most basic dishes, like Nod-Krai Hot Dogs. Come back and show me once you're done.
Mmm, the sausage is nicely grilled.
You'd make a half-decent sous chef if you were working in a restaurant outside, I'd say.
But we're making meals for every Ratnik on this island. So it's not about how fancy the food is, but whether it's plentiful enough.
Make the bread thicker. There's not a ton of vegetables right now, and you could also add some meats apart from sausages.
You still need more practice! Come back next time and make some Berries and Fried Meat.
Mm. The meat's been sliced into sizable chunks, then fried perfectly after that. Not bad.
But let me remind you. When making fried meat, you must consider your side dishes.
It's easy to get stuffed from eating too much meat. That's why the berries are there.
Here on this island, we're in charge of everyone's dietary health, so a balance must be struck between vegetables and meat.
This dish doesn't have enough such veggies on the side. We can't have that here.
You need to practice more. Come back next time and whip up some Lakkaberry Madame.
The chicken's flavorful, and there are sufficient side dishes. You tryin' to make it tough for me to nitpick, huh?
...Heh. Whatever. Not that I was ever looking to find fault with you newbies specifically.
I'm just a chef. I just do my job, and I want to do it well.
And to that end, I made all kinds of preparations for the Wild Hunt's arrival.
But it's a pity... I couldn't send them the finished dishes in time... The food wound up spilled... spilled...

quests.description: Listen to the ghosts’ whispers and retrieve their names.
